//: Copy this file to deploy.config.json and fill it in. Keep the real one off source control — it holds a password.
//password: Leave empty and set privateKeyPath instead if the host uses key auth (sftp only).
//hostKeyFingerprint: sftp only, WinSCP format e.g. ssh-ed25519 255 xx:xx:... . Leave empty to accept any key (less safe).
//remoteBrowserPath: Where the client bundle and assets go — the folder the web server serves.
//remoteServerPath: Where the SSR bundle goes. Must match SERVER_DIST on the host.
//remoteWebConfigPath: Full remote path for web.config. Set to "" to skip uploading it.
//removeStale: true lets the upload DELETE remote files that are no longer in the build (clears old main-*.js). Only enable once you are certain the remote paths are right.
